Name: Kenneth's Mine Loot Addon
Author: Kf29
Description:
[size=4][b]This is a small addon for Kenneth's Grocery Store. It puts 7 vanilla mine items into Shop6, for days when you just do not feel like going down the mines.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]What you get is stone, coal, copper ore, iron ore, gold ore, iridium ore, and radioactive ore. All vanilla items, no new sprites and no config. Stock is unlimited, so you can buy a few for a quick craft or a whole stack for a big build.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]You will need Kenneth's Grocery Store installed, since this addon only adds items to its Shop6. It also needs Content Patcher to run.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Install is the usual flow. Drop this folder into your Mods folder together with Kenneth's Grocery Store, then start the game. If Shop6 looks empty, check that the base Grocery Store mod is enabled first.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Made for players who want to skip the grind sometimes and just buy the ores they need for furnaces, crafting, and upgrades.[/b][/size]

Manifest.Name: Kenneth's Mine Loot Addon
Manifest.Description: Adds Mine Loot (Stone, Coal, Copper Ore, Iron Ore, Gold Ore, Iridium Ore, Radioactive Ore, Quartz, Fire Quartz) to Kenneth's Grocery Store Shop6. Requires Kenneth's Grocery Store.
